start: Workout tab, Up next shows 'Pull A', no workout open

steps.action: Tap Start on the Up next card
user_sees: The workout screen opens once with Pull A's exercises

start: Today page with nothing shown (rest day or no plan)

user_sees: An empty workout opens at once, filled with the last workout's exercises (blank when none)
must_not: A workout of an old plan day

start: A live workout with 3 ticked sets is open; member opens a routine page

user_sees: 'Resume it, or discard it and start this one. Discarding deletes its 3 sets.'
Buttons 'Discard and start new' and 'Resume workout'
must_not: The open workout replaced without asking

start: Member is editing a saved past workout, then taps Start on the Workout tab

user_sees: 'Resume editing, or discard your changes (the saved workout stays as it was) and go on.'
must_not: The edit opened with no word

start: A workout was open when Android closed the app

steps.action: Open the app and tap Start on the Up next card
user_sees: The saved workout loads and resumes
must_not: A new workout replacing the saved one

steps.action: From a routine page choose 'Discard and start new'
user_sees: The old workout is deleted and the new one opens
must_not: The old sets saved as a workout
